 Hello Darcy, 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 We hope you're doing well and staying cozy as the days get shorter and the chill of fall settles in.
If you need a little boost, we've got just the thing:

 Our annual fall contest! 

 Just a quick reminder — Every year at Lasclay, this unique event is replacing the usual Black Friday promotions and takes place over a much longer period: between October 18 and December 15.

 And this year, the Grand Prize is truly special: a trip to Mexico to explore the Monarch Butterfly Biosphere Reserve , a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a dream destination for any milkweed / monarch butterfly enthusiast!

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 To participate, you must: 

 

 1. Like, comment & share the contest’s Facebook post. (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K8ZTZAZB7R7113YGV47JNBZ8_0)

2. Make a purchase on lasclay.com (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K8ZTZAZB7R7113YGV47JNBZ8_1)

 It's truly a great opportunity to gear up for the cold season or to give our high-performance, eco-friendly products as gifts. Everything is made right here from start to finish and insulated with locally grown milkweed floss! 

 

 
 To learn more about the contest and this week's promotions, click here 👇 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Learn more about the contest (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K8ZTZAZB7R7113YGV47JNBZ8_2)
 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Link if the button doesn't work: https://lasclay.com/en-us/pages/november25-contest (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K8ZTZAZB7R7113YGV47JNBZ8_3) 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 Surprise: new products for little gifts! 

 We’re very proud to launch a new collection of milkweed and monarchs inspired items . Announced exclusively in this newsletter, this collection was created to support our mission of restoring monarch butterfly populations and promoting milkweed .

 Our first two products are laser-engraved wooden coasters (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K8ZTZAZB7R7113YGV47JNBZ8_4) and keychains (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K8ZTZAZB7R7113YGV47JNBZ8_5), made with the same automated machines that cut our milkweed-insulated textile products . And this is just the beginning, as more creations will be added in the coming months!

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 This week's promotions 

 Throughout the fall contest, weekly promotions will give you a little boost as you get ready for winter or start planning your Christmas gifts!

 Here are this week’s promotions (Nov. 1 to Nov. 8): 

 
MIlkweed-insulated phone satchel (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K8ZTZAZB7R7113YGV47JNBZ8_6) – 20% off
Milkweed-insulated quilted scarf (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K8ZTZAZB7R7113YGV47JNBZ8_7) – 20% off
 Milkweed insoles (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K8ZTZAZB7R7113YGV47JNBZ8_8) – 10% off

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Thank you so much Darcy to be part of our community, we're so grateful to have you here.

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Warmly,

 Gabriel 
Co-founder
Lasclay

Hi Darcy,
 

 We have received your message and are doing our utmost to respond and assist you as quickly as possible. It's a busy time for messages, and our customer service team is still quite small: just 1 full-time person and me, who helps out occasionally amidst my dozens of other tasks!
 

 Rest assured, however, that your situation will not be overlooked, and we will take care of it as soon as possible. It is understood that the return period applies from the time the customer notifies us of a desire to make an exchange or a refund, not from when we have time to respond. Serving our customers well is a high priority for us, even if we are sometimes a bit overwhelmed.
 

 In short, we haven't forgotten about you and we're working hard to not let you down!
